name: material
title: Material
description: An entity that can be identified, exist for some period of time, and consist in whole or in part of physical matter while it exists.
notes: The term is defined at the most general level to admit descriptions of any subtype of material entity within the scope of Darwin Core. In particular, any kind of material sample, preserved specimen, fossil, or exemplar from living collections is intended to be subsumed under this term.
examples: `the entire contents of a trawl`; `a subset of the contents of a trawl`; `the body of a fish`; `the stomach contents of a fish`; `a rock containing fossils`; `a fossil within a rock`; `an herbarium sheet with its attached plant specimen`; `a flower on a plant specimen`; `a pollen grain`; `a specific water sample`; `an isolated molecule of DNA`
rdfs:comment: An entity that can be identified, exists for some period of time, and consists in whole or in part of physical matter while it exists.

fields.name: materialEntity_pk
fields.title: Material Entity (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a particular instance of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: materialEntityID
fields.title: Material Entity ID
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: The value in this field MUST be preserved in aggregation. Recommended best practice is to use a globally unique identifier.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a particular instance of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: digitalSpecimenID
fields.title: Digital Specimen ID
fields.description: An identifier for a Digital Specimen resource.
fields.notes: A Digital Specimen is defined in https://doi.org/10.3897/rio.7.e67379. A dwc:digitalSpecimenID is intended to uniquely and persistently identify a Digital Specimen. Recommended best practice is to use a DOI with machine readable metadata in the DOI record that uses a community agreed metadata profile (also known as FDO profile) for a Digital Specimen. For an example see: https://doi.org/10.3535/N75-CR4-0SM?noredirect. The identifier is for a digital information artifact (the Digital Specimen) as opposed to an identifier for a specific instance of a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a Digital Specimen resource.

fields.name: collectionEvent_fk
fields.title: Collection Event (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:Event during which a dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for the set of information associated with a dwc:Event (something that occurs at a place and time). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: evidenceForOccurrence_fk
fields.title: Evidence For Occurrence (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:Occurrence for which a dwc:MaterialEntity provides evidence.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a dwc:Occurrence (as opposed to a particular digital record of a dwc:Occurrence).

fields.name: derivedFromMaterialEntity_fk
fields.title: Derived From Material Entity (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:MaterialEntity from which this dwc:MaterialEntity was derived.
fields.notes: This dwc:MaterialEntity is separate from a dwc:MaterialEntity from which it was derived (cf. dwc:isPartOfMaterialEntityID). The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a particular instance of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: derivedFromMaterialEntityID
fields.title: Derived From Material Entity ID
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:MaterialEntity from which this dwc:MaterialEntity was derived.
fields.notes: This dwc:MaterialEntity is separate from a dwc:MaterialEntity from which it was derived (cf. dwc:isPartOfMaterialEntityID). Recommended best practice is to use a globally unique identifier. The value in this field MAY refer to a dwc:MaterialEntity within or external to the dataset in which this record originated.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a particular instance of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: derivationEvent_fk
fields.title: Derivation Event (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:Event during which a dwc:MaterialEntity was derived from another dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for the set of information associated with a dwc:Event (something that occurs at a place and time). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: isPartOfMaterialEntity_fk
fields.title: Is Part Of Material Entity (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:MaterialEntity of which this dwc:MaterialEntity is a part.
fields.notes: This dwc:MaterialEntity was not taken from a dwc:MaterialEntity of which it is a part. The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a dwc:MaterialEntity of which this dwc:MaterialEntity is a part.

fields.name: isPartOfMaterialEntityID
fields.title: Is Part Of Material Entity ID
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:MaterialEntity of which this dwc:MaterialEntity is a part.
fields.notes: This dwc:MaterialEntity was not taken from a dwc:MaterialEntity of which it is a part. Recommended best practice is to use a globally unique identifier. The value in this field MAY refer to a dwc:MaterialEntity within or external to the dataset in which this record originated.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a dwc:MaterialEntity of which this dwc:MaterialEntity is a part.

fields.name: materialRole
fields.title: Material Role
fields.description: A category that best matches the nature of the relationship between a dwc:MaterialEntity and another dwc:MaterialEntity of which it is a part.
fields.rdfs:comment: A category that best matches the nature of the relationship between a dwc:MaterialEntity and another dwc:MaterialEntity of which it is a part.

fields.name: materialProportion
fields.title: Material Proportion
fields.description: The qualitative or quantitative abundance of a dwc:MaterialEntity with respect to another dwc:MaterialEntity of which it is a part.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary such as http://resource.geosciml.org/classifier/cgi/proportionterm. This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
fields.rdfs:comment: The qualitative or quantitative abundance of a dwc:MaterialEntity with respect to another dwc:MaterialEntity of which it is a part.

fields.name: materialEntityCategory
fields.title: Material Entity Category
fields.description: A high-level, mutually exclusive classification describing the fundamental substance and origin of a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a limited, tightly controlled vocabulary.
fields.rdfs:comment: A high-level, mutually exclusive classification describing the fundamental substance and origin of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: materialEntityType
fields.title: Material Entity Type
fields.description: A more generic classification of a dwc:MaterialEntity than dwc:preparations but less broad than dwc:materialCategory.
fields.notes: A more generic classification of a dwc:MaterialEntity than dwc:preparations. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
fields.examples: `Macro-object`; `Micro-object`; `Oversized object`; `Cut/polished gemstone`; `Compound Specimen`; `Core`; `Mixed Materials`; `Environmental sample`; `Microscope slide`; `Spore print`; `Macrofossil`; `Mesofossil`; `Microfossil`; `Pinned object/specimen`; `Taxidermy mount`; `Blood sampling cards`; `Oversized fossil`; `Anthropogenic Artifact`
fields.rdfs:comment: A more generic classification of a dwc:MaterialEntity than dwc:preparations but less broad than dwc:materialCategory.

fields.name: discipline
fields.title: Discipline
fields.description: The primary branch or branches of knowledge represented by a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: This term can be used to classify records according to branches of knowledge. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary and to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space (` | `). It is also recommended to use this field to describe specimenType in MIDS.
fields.rdfs:comment: The primary branch or branches of knowledge represented by a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: sampledFeatureType
fields.title: Sampled Feature Type
fields.description: The type of naturally occurring or anthropogenic physical feature from which a dwc:MaterialEntity was sampled.
fields.notes: This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
fields.rdfs:comment: The type of naturally occurring or anthropogenic physical feature from which a dwc:MaterialEntity was sampled.

fields.name: institutionCode
fields.title: Institution Code
fields.description: A name (or acronym) in use by an institution having custody of a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.rdfs:comment: A name (or acronym) in use by an institution having custody of a resource.

fields.name: institutionID
fields.title: Institution ID
fields.description: An identifier for an organization.
fields.notes: For physical specimens, the recommended best practice is to use a globally unique and resolvable identifier from a collections registry such as the Research Organization Registry (ROR) or the Global Registry of Scientific Collections (https://scientific-collections.gbif.org/). The value in this field MAY refer to a dcterms:Agent within or external to the dataset in which this record originated.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for an organization.

fields.name: ownerInstitutionCode
fields.title: Owner Institution Code
fields.description: A name (or acronym) in use by an institution having ownership of a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.rdfs:comment: A name (or acronym) in use by an institution having ownership of a resource.

fields.name: ownerInstitutionID
fields.title: Owner Institution ID
fields.description: An identifier for an institution that owns a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: For physical specimens, the recommended best practice is to use a globally unique and resolvable identifier from a collections registry such as the Research Organization Registry (ROR) or the Global Registry of Scientific Collections (https://scientific-collections.gbif.org/). The value in this field MAY refer to a dcterms:Agent within or external to the dataset in which this record originated.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent.

fields.name: collectionCode
fields.title: Collection Code
fields.description: A name, acronym, coden, or initialism identifying a collection.
fields.rdfs:comment: A name, acronym, coden, or initialism identifying a collection.

fields.name: collectionID
fields.title: Collection ID
fields.description: An identifier for a collection.
fields.notes: For physical specimens, the recommended best practice is to use a globally unique and resolvable identifier from a collections registry such as the Global Registry of Scientific Collections (https://scientific-collections.gbif.org/).
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a collection.

fields.name: catalogNumber
fields.title: Catalog Number
fields.description: An identifier (preferably unique) for a dwc:MaterialEntity within a collection.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier (preferably unique) for a resource within a collection.

fields.name: otherCatalogNumbers
fields.title: Other Catalog Numbers
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of previous or alternate fully qualified catalog numbers or other human-used identifiers for the same dwc:MaterialEntity, whether in the current or any other data set or collection.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space (` | `).
fields.rdfs:comment: A list (concatenated and separated) of previous or alternate fully qualified catalog numbers or other human-used identifiers for the same dwc:MaterialEntity, whether in the current or any other data set or collection.

fields.name: collectorNumber
fields.title: Collector Number
fields.description: An identifier given to a dwc:MaterialEntity at the time it was collected.
fields.notes: Often serves as a link between field notes and a dwc:MaterialEntity, such as a specimen collector's number.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier given to the dwc:Occurrence at the time it was recorded. Often serves as a link between field notes and a dwc:Occurrence record, such as a specimen collector's number.

fields.name: collectedBy
fields.title: Collected By
fields.description: A name for a dcterms:Agent responsible for recording a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space (` | `).
fields.examples: `José E. Crespo`; `Oliver P. Pearson | Anita K. Pearson` (where the value in dwc:collectorNumber `OPP 7101` corresponds to the collector number for the specimen in the field catalog of Oliver P. Pearson)
fields.rdfs:comment: A name for a dcterms:Agent responsible for recording a dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: collectedByID
fields.title: Collected By ID
fields.description: An identifier for the dcterms:Agent responsible for collecting a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY refer to a dcterms:Agent within or external to the dataset in which this record originated.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for recording a dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: objectQuantity
fields.title: Object Quantity
fields.description: A number or enumeration value for the quantity of differentiable dwc:MaterialEntities comprising this dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: An dwc:objectQuantity must have a corresponding dwc:objectQuantityType.
fields.rdfs:comment: A number or enumeration value for the quantity of differentiable dwc:MaterialEntities comprising this dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: objectQuantityType
fields.title: Object Quantity Type
fields.description: The type of quantification system used for the quantity of dwc:MaterialEntities.
fields.notes: An dwc:objectQuantityType must have a corresponding dwc:objectQuantity.
fields.rdfs:comment: The type of quantification system used for the quantity of dwc:MaterialEntities.

fields.name: preparations
fields.title: Preparations
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of preparations and preservation methods for a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space (` | `). This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
fields.rdfs:comment: A list (concatenated and separated) of preparations and preservation methods for a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: disposition
fields.title: Disposition
fields.description: A current state of a dwc:MaterialEntity with respect to where it can be found.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
fields.rdfs:comment: A current state of a dwc:MaterialEntity with respect to where it can be found.

fields.name: measuredMassInGrams
fields.title: Measured Mass In Grams
fields.description: Mass of a dwc:MaterialEntity, measured in grams.
fields.rdfs:comment: Mass of a dwc:MaterialEntity, measured in grams.

fields.name: verbatimMass
fields.title: Verbatim Mass
fields.description: The verbatim original representation of the mass of a dwc:MaterialEntity, including original units of measurement.
fields.rdfs:comment: The verbatim original representation of the mass of a dwc:MaterialEntity, including original units of measurement.

fields.name: verbatimLabel
fields.title: Verbatim Label
fields.description: A verbatim original representation of the written information affixed or related to a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: The content of this term should include no embellishments, prefixes, headers or other additions made to the text. Abbreviations must not be expanded and supposed misspellings must not be corrected. Lines or breakpoints between blocks of text that could be verified by seeing the original labels or images of them may be used. Examples of material entities include preserved specimens, fossil specimens, and material samples. Best practice is to use UTF-8 for all characters. Best practice is to add comment “verbatimLabel derived from human transcription” in dwc:materialEntityRemarks. Examples can be found at https://dwc.tdwg.org/examples/verbatimLabel.
fields.rdfs:comment: A verbatim original representation of the written information affixed or related to a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: associatedSequences
fields.title: Associated Sequences
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of dcterms:BibliographicResources for dwc:NucleotideSequences associated with a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.rdfs:comment: A list (concatenated and separated) of dcterms:BibliographicResources for dwc:NucleotideSequences associated with a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: materialReferences
fields.title: Material References
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of dcterms:BibliographicResources associated with a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space ( | ). Note that the intended usage of the term dcterms:references in Darwin Core is to point to the definitive source representation of the resource, if one is available. Note also that the intended usage of dcterms:bibliographicCitation in Darwin Core is to provide the preferred way to cite the resource itself.
fields.examples: `http://www.sciencemag.org/cgi/content/abstract/322/5899/261`; `Christopher J. Conroy, Jennifer L. Neuwald. 2008. Phylogeographic study of the California vole, Microtus californicus Journal of Mammalogy, 89(3):755-767.`; `Steven R. Hoofer and Ronald A. Van Den Bussche. 2001. Phylogenetic Relationships of Plecotine Bats and Allies Based on Mitochondrial Ribosomal Sequences. Journal of Mammalogy 82(1):131-137. | Walker, Faith M., Jeffrey T. Foster, Kevin P. Drees, Carol L. Chambers. 2014. Spotted bat (Euderma maculatum) microsatellite discovery using illumina sequencing. Conservation Genetics Resources.`; `https://doi.org/10.3897/BDJ.14.e177525`
fields.rdfs:comment: A list (concatenated and separated) of associated dcterms:BibliographicResources.

fields.name: treatments
fields.title: Treatments
fields.description: Description of any processes or curatorial actions taken specifically to mitigate damage to a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: Includes both proactive and reactive actions.
fields.rdfs:comment: Description of any processes or curatorial actions taken specifically to mitigate damage to a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: handlingRequirements
fields.title: Handling Requirements
fields.description: A description of the procedures required to preserve and protect a dwc:MaterialEntity during handling.
fields.examples: `handle with gloves`; `not to be taken out of storage medium`; `avoid contact with direct sunlight`
fields.rdfs:comment: A description of the procedures required to preserve and protect a dwc:MaterialEntity during handling.

fields.name: hazardType
fields.title: Hazard Type
fields.description: A term that belongs to a hazard classification scheme based on a set of unique characteristics and negative health outcomes.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary such as https://kos.geospecimens.org/vocab/hazard-type. This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
fields.rdfs:comment: A term that belongs to a hazard classification scheme based on a set of unique characteristics and negative health outcomes.

fields.name: hazardRemarks
fields.title: Hazard Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the type of hazards associated with a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.rdfs:comment: Comments or notes about the type of hazards associated with a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: damageRemarks
fields.title: Damage Remarks
fields.description: A general description of any physical changes to a dwc:MaterialEntity that have negatively affected its value.
fields.notes: See Royce, K., Baars, C., & Viles, H. (2021). Defining Damage and Susceptibility, with Implications for Mineral Specimens and Objects: Introducing the Mineral Susceptibility Database. Studies in Conservation, 68(3), 298-317. https://doi.org/10.1080/00393630.2021.2015947
fields.examples: `Due to oxidation and hydration of the pyrite in the coal, the sample has largely decayed to a coal powder with some larger coal pieces | Some terminations broken off | Attached label not legible (or torn, or covered)`
fields.rdfs:comment: A general description of any physical changes to a dwc:MaterialEntity that have negatively affected its value.

fields.name: materialDescription
fields.title: Material Description
fields.description: Remarks on the physical characteristics of a dwc:MaterialEntity, particularly those that distinguish it from otherwise similar dwc:MaterialEntities.
fields.rdfs:comment: Remarks on the physical characteristics of a dwc:MaterialEntity, particularly those that distinguish it from otherwise similar dwc:MaterialEntities.

fields.name: materialEntityRemarks
fields.title: Material Entity Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.examples: `found in association with charred remains`; `some original fragments missing`
fields.rdfs:comment: Comments or notes about a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: verbatimIdentification
fields.title: Verbatim Identification
fields.description: A string representing the classification as it appeared in the original record.
fields.notes: This term is meant to allow the capture of an unaltered original identification/determination, including identification qualifiers, hybrid formulas, uncertainties, etc. This term is meant to be used in addition to dwc:geologicalMaterialName or dwc:scientificName (and dwc:identificationQualifier etc.), not instead of it.
fields.examples: `Peromyscus sp.`; `Ministrymon sp. nov. 1`; `Anser anser × Branta canadensis`; `Pachyporidae?`, `Potentilla × pantotricha Soják`; `Aconitum pilipes × A. variegatum; `Lepomis auritus x cyanellus`
fields.rdfs:comment: A string representing the classification as it appeared in the original record.

fields.name: typeStatus
fields.title: Type Status
fields.description: A nomenclatural type (type status, typified scientific name, publication) applied to the subject.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space (` | `). This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
fields.rdfs:comment: A nomenclatural type (type status, typified scientific name, publication) applied to the subject.

fields.name: typeDesignationType
fields.title: typeDesignationType
fields.description: A category that best matches the nature of a type designation.
fields.notes: From https://rs.gbif.org/extension/gbif/1.0/typesandspecimen.xml.
fields.rdfs:comment: The reason why this specimen or name is designated as a type.

fields.name: typeOfType
fields.title: Type Of Type
fields.description: A category of nomenclatural type of a dwc:MaterialEntity.
fields.notes: The term dwc:typeOfType must be used in combination with dwc:typifiedName. Together they make up the type status of a specimen. Note that relatively very few specimens are nomenclatural types (types of names), so in most cases this term will have no value. Unlike dwc:typeStatus, dwc:typeOfType can only have a single value. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary such as the GBIF Nomenclatural Type Status Vocabulary. This term has an equivalent in the tcs: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
fields.rdfs:comment: A category of nomenclatural type of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: typifiedName
fields.title: Typified Name
fields.description: A scientific name for which a specimen or other name is the type.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is also to indicate the dwc:typeStatus of the specimen.
fields.rdfs:comment: A scientific name for which a specimen or other name is the type.

fields.name: identifiedBy
fields.title: Identified By
fields.description: A name for a dcterms:Agent responsible for making a dwc:Identification.
fields.notes: When used in the context of an eco:Survey, the subject consists of all of the dwc:Identifications related to the eco:Survey. Recommended best practice is to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space (` | `).
fields.rdfs:comment: A name for a dcterms:Agent responsible for making a dwc:Identification.

fields.name: identifiedBy_fk
fields.title: Identified By (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for making a dwc:Identification.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.examples: `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097` (for an individual); `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097 | https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0098` (for a list of people)
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for making a dwc:Identification.

fields.name: identifiedByID
fields.title: Identified By ID
fields.description: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for making a dwc:Identification.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY refer to a dcterms:Agent within or external to the dataset in which this record originated.
fields.examples: `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097` (for an individual); `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097 | https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0098` (for a list of people)
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a dcterms:Agent responsible for making a dwc:Identification.

fields.name: dateIdentified
fields.title: Date Identified
fields.description: The date on which the subject was determined as representing the dwc:Taxon.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a date that conforms to ISO 8601-1:2019.
fields.examples: `1963-03-08T14:07-06:00` (8 Mar 1963 at or after 2:07pm and before 2:08pm in the time zone six hours earlier than UTC); `2009-02-20T08:40Z` (20 February 2009 at or after 8:40am and before 8:41 UTC); `2018-08-29T15:19` (29 August 2018 at or after 3:19pm and before 3:20pm local time); `1809-02-12` (within the day 12 February 1809); `1906-06` (in the month of June 1906); `1971` (in the year 1971); `2007-03-01T13:00:00Z/2008-05-11T15:30:00Z` (some time within the interval beginning 1 March 2007 at 1pm UTC and before 11 May 2008 at 3:30pm UTC); `1900/1909` (some time within the interval between the beginning of the year 1900 and before the year 1909); `2007-11-13/15` (some time in the interval between the beginning of 13 November 2007 and before 15 November 2007)
fields.rdfs:comment: The date on which the subject was determined as representing the dwc:Taxon.

fields.name: identificationReferences
fields.title: Identification References
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of dcterms:BibliographicResources used in a dwc:Identification.
fields.notes: When used in the context of an eco:Survey, the subject consists of all of the dwc:Identifications related to the eco:Survey. Recommended best practice is to separate the values in a list with space vertical bar space (` | `).
fields.examples: `Aves del Noroeste Patagonico. Christie et al. 2004.`; `Stebbins, R. Field Guide to Western Reptiles and Amphibians. 3rd Edition. 2003. | Irschick, D.J. and Shaffer, H.B. (1997). The polytypic species revisited: Morphological differentiation among tiger salamanders (Ambystoma tigrinum) (Amphibia: Caudata). Herpetologica, 53(1), 30-49.`
fields.rdfs:comment: A list (concatenated and separated) of dcterms:BibliographicResources used in a dwc:Identification.

fields.name: identificationVerificationStatus
fields.title: Identification Verification Status
fields.description: A categorical indicator of the extent to which a dwc:Identification has been verified to be correct.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary such as that used in HISPID and ABCD. This term has an equivalent in the dwciri: namespace that allows only an IRI as a value, whereas this term allows for any string literal value.
fields.rdfs:comment: A categorical indicator of the extent to which a taxonomic determination has been verified to be correct.

fields.name: identificationRemarks
fields.title: Identification Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about a dwc:Identification.
fields.examples: `Distinguished between Anthus correndera and Anthus hellmayri based on the comparative lengths of the uñas.`
fields.rdfs:comment: Comments or notes about the dwc:Identification.

fields.name: taxonID
fields.title: Taxon ID
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:Taxon.
fields.notes: In DwC-DP, the dwc:taxonID is always an external link to a taxon record. As such, if present, it should be a resolvable globally unique identifier. See the Identifiers section of https://github.com/CatalogueOfLife/coldp/blob/master/README.md.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a dwc:Taxon.

fields.name: scientificNameID
fields.title: Scientific Name ID
fields.description: An identifier for the nomenclatural (not taxonomic) details of a scientific name.
fields.notes: In DwC-DP, the dwc:scientificNameID is always an external link to a taxon record. As such, if present, it should be a resolvable globally unique identifier. See the Identifiers section of https://github.com/CatalogueOfLife/coldp/blob/master/README.md.
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for the nomenclatural (not taxonomic) details of a scientific name.

fields.name: scientificName
fields.title: Scientific Name
fields.description: A scientific name string, not including authorship, date or identification qualifiers.
fields.examples: `Coleoptera` (order); `Vespertilionidae` (family); `Manis` (genus); `Ctenomys sociabilis` (genus + specificEpithet); `Ambystoma tigrinum diaboli` (genus + specificEpithet + infraspecificEpithet); `Quercus agrifolia var. oxyadenia` (genus + specificEpithet + taxonRank + infraspecificEpithet); `×Agropogon littoralis`; `Mentha ×smithiana`; `Agrostis stolonifera L. × Polypogon monspeliensis`
fields.rdfs:comment: The full scientific name, with authorship and date information if known. When forming part of a dwc:Identification, this should be the name in lowest level taxonomic rank that can be determined.

fields.name: scientificNameAuthorship
fields.title: Scientific Name Authorship
fields.description: The authorship information for a dwc:scientificName formatted according to the conventions of the applicable dwc:nomenclaturalCode.
fields.rdfs:comment: The authorship information for the dwc:scientificName formatted according to the conventions of the applicable dwc:nomenclaturalCode.

fields.name: vernacularName
fields.title: Vernacular Name
fields.description: A common or vernacular name.
fields.rdfs:comment: A common or vernacular name.

fields.name: taxonRank
fields.title: Taxon Rank
fields.description: A taxonomic rank of the most specific name in a dwc:scientificName.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary. The taxon ranks of algae, fungi and plants are defined in the International Code of Nomenclature for algae, fungi, and plants (Shenzhen Code Articles H3.2, H4.4 and H.3.1).
fields.rdfs:comment: The taxonomic rank of the most specific name in the dwc:scientificName.

fields.name: externalClassificationSource
fields.title: External Classification Source
fields.description: A reference to a source outside the dataset where the identifying name, code, or taxon concept can be found.
fields.notes: The external source applies to whichever of dwc:taxonID, dwc:scientificNameID, minext:geoClassificationCode, minext:geoName, dwc:scientificName, or dwc:vernacularName is populated.
fields.examples: `http://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/`; `https://avibase.bsc-eoc.org/`; `Dana, J. D., Dana, E. S., & Gaines, R. V. (1997). Dana's new mineralogy: The system of mineralogy of James Dwight Dana and Edward Salisbury Dana.`; `Strunz H, Nickel EH (2001) Strunz Mineralogical Tables, 9th Edition. Berlin and Stuttgart 870 pp.`
fields.rdfs:comment: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

fields.name: modified
fields.title: Modified
fields.description: Date on which the resource was changed.
fields.notes: Date that the digital record of the material resource was altered. The date and time MUST comply with the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) datetime practice, https://www.w3.org/TR/NOTE-datetime, which requires that date and time representation correspond to ISO 8601:1998, https://www.iso.org/standard/40874.html, but with year fields always comprising 4 digits. This makes datetime records compliant with 8601:2004. AC datetime values MAY also follow 8601:2004 for ranges by separating two ISO 8601 datetime fields by a solidus ("forward slash", '/'). dcterms:modified permits all modification dates to be recorded, or if only one is recorded, it is assumed to be the latest. See also the Wikipedia ISO 8601 entry, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601, for further explanation and examples.
fields.rdfs:comment: Date on which the resource was changed.

fields.name: provenance_fk
fields.title: Provenance (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:Provenance.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a dwc:Provenance.

fields.name: usagePolicy_fk
fields.title: Usage Policy (Foreign Key)
fields.description: An identifier for a dwc:UsagePolicy.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: An identifier for a dwc:UsagePolicy.

fields.name: owner
fields.title: Owner
fields.description: A list of legal owners of the resource.
fields.notes: `unknown`
fields.examples: `The names of the owners `Ron Thomas, Roz Thomas` or a URI that identifies the owner`
fields.rdfs:comment: A list of legal owners of the resource.

fields.name: license
fields.title: License
fields.description: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.
fields.notes: Recommended practice is to identify the license document with a URI. If this is not possible or feasible, a literal value that identifies the license may be provided.
fields.rdfs:comment: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

fields.name: informationWithheld
fields.title: Information Withheld
fields.description: Additional information that exists about a resource, but that is not shared publicly. Suggests that alternative data of higher quality may be available on request.
fields.examples: `location information not given for endangered species`; `collector identities withheld | ask about tissue samples`
fields.rdfs:comment: Additional information that exists about a resource, but that is not shared publicly. Suggests that alternative data of higher quality may be available on request.

fields.name: dataGeneralizations
fields.title: Data Generalizations
fields.description: Actions taken to make the shared data less specific or complete than in its original form. Suggests that alternative data of higher quality may be available on request.
fields.examples: `Coordinates generalized from original GPS coordinates to the nearest half degree grid cell.`
fields.rdfs:comment: Actions taken to make the shared data less specific or complete than in its original form. Suggests that alternative data of higher quality may be available on request.

fields.name: feedbackURL
fields.title: Feedback URL
fields.description: A uniform resource locator (URL) that points to a webpage on which a form may be submitted to gather feedback about the record.
fields.notes: Recommended best practice is to optionally include query strings that act to pre-populate web page form elements and communicate the context.
fields.rdfs:comment: A uniform resource locator (URL) that points to a webpage on which a form may be submitted to gather feedback about the record.
